referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the material use for the manufacturing of simple sanitary installations in an office building according to Klingler and Kasser, 2011 per energy reference area. The sanitary system has a life-span of 30 years. Transport is included. The average energy reference area ist 5131 m2. The building has 16 sanitary rooms and 3 installation zones.
